thread:
anna: quick note — discovered captions dropout on registration page test. transcript not attaching to recording in HubSpot. anyone else see this?

devon: saw the same during rehearsal, captions were fine live but the cloud transcript file wasn't linked.

kevin: probably a Zoom cloud export setting. check auto-transcribe + auto-record to cloud are both on. I can flip them and run a test.

luis: we need the transcript attached to the HubSpot lead record + CTA timestamps for the 3 clips. also want SRT + plain text for repurposing.

kevin: here's what I toggled in test account:
```
Settings > Recording > Cloud recording: on
Save captions: on
Auto-transcribe: on
```
I'll re-run the "soundcheck" meeting 11:45 PT.

zoom-bot: Recording processed and transcript generated (meeting id 845-1234). Cloud files: mp4, vtt, transcript.txt

anna: perfect. once transcript appears, can we run the transcript->chapters script and output JSON timestamps for clips?

devon: yes — I'll kick off the script and push results to /marketing/webinars/2026-03-21/event-clip-manifest.json. Clips: intro (0:00-2:20), benchmark section (12:10-16:05), demo highlight (27:33-30:02)

luis: routing — confirmed: Zapier webhook on new recording will create HubSpot engagement + attach transcript and set property "webinar:2026_march". devon, can you add UTM params for the replay link in the nurture email?

devon: yep. UTM source=webinar, campaign=redwood_inference_launch, content=on-demand. sending draft for review in #marketing in 30m.

anna: follow-up cadence proposal: Day 0: thanks + on-demand recording + short TL;DR + transcript link; Day 3: clip email focusing on benchmarks; Day 7: sales outreach for MQLs who watched >30%; Day 14: final reminder + survey. Thoughts?

kevin: make sure we record retention policy: cloud files to S3 via export with retention 90 days then archive. I'll add lifecycle rule.

luis: quick nit — make transcript accessible: include vtt captions on embed player and attach txt file. Also add alt text to thumbnail and accessible registration confirmation email.

anna: assigning owners: devon (nurture copy + UTM), kevin (zoom settings + export), luis (zap + hubspot mapping), anna (event ops + a11y checklist).

devon: noted. I'll post the copy draft in 30.

luis: one more — for clips we should auto-generate social cuts (30s/60s) and push to shared drive with filenames including timestamp and speaker tags.

anna: ✅ can we add that to the clip manifest? devon, please add tags for social assets.

zoom-bot: Export complete: mp4 + vtt + transcript.txt uploaded to s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-03-21/1768504321/

kevin: closing loop — tests passed. will monitor for first live webinar tomorrow. ping me if transcripts fail.

anna: thanks team :sparkles: great work — I'll drop final checklist in #marketing and schedule a briefing with sales for Monday.
